guide.priorLine: This account (a Barça-focused video creator) posts mostly about Barça transfers, squad drama, and player news, but frequently pads its feed with World Cup highlights of non-Barça players and other clubs' stories, so expect a strong but not exclusive Barça focus.

onBeatPatterns.pattern: Transfer-target updates for players linked to Barça (Alvarez, Adeyemi, Ferran, etc.)
examplesEnglish: Atletico will NOT sell Julian Alvarez! Full reaction to some big words from Atléti 🔽
JULIAN WANTS TO LEAVE ATLÉTI! He's gone public! But what happens next? 🔽

onBeatPatterns.pattern: Internal squad/relationship drama involving current Barça players (De Jong, Fermín, new signings)
examplesEnglish: Frenkie de Jong and Hansi Flick's relationship is reportedly 'broken' - some thoughts 🔽 Plus, Adeyemi's arrival!
I feel like at some point there are surely only so many excuses you can make for Frenkie de Jong.

onBeatPatterns.pattern: Cryptic teaser posts about managerial pressure/speculation at Barça (paired with Flick/Mourinho-style imagery)
examplesEnglish: This really is getting ridiculous now...
This is all getting a little concerning...

onBeatPatterns.pattern: Round-up threads combining Barça transfer news with World Cup context
Milestone/performance posts about current Barça players (e.g. Lamine Yamal) even while on national duty
examplesEnglish: LAMINE YAMAL SCORES AT THE WORLD CUP!
Safe to say that Spain BADLY need Lamine.

offBeatPatterns.pattern: Highlight/reaction posts about non-Barça players' World Cup moments (Messi, Ronaldo, Gordon, Neves, Barcola, etc.)
examplesEnglish: LIONEL MESSI HAS REACHED BACK-TO-BACK WORLD CUP FINALS!!
Spain eliminate Portugal! And last night was a complete embarrassment for Cristiano Ronaldo & Roberto Martinez...

offBeatPatterns.pattern: Other clubs' transfer or squad news with no Barcelona angle
examplesEnglish: PSG's options on the left-wing next season will be Kvaratskhelia AND Diomande. Oh, and Doue can also play there. Insane 🤯

offBeatPatterns.pattern: Engagement-bait or meta posts unrelated to actual news (polls, fan replies, promo items)
examplesEnglish: IMAGINE the reaction if Barça did this 😂
World Cup fever has officially struck!
